#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TASK-20260923-e3b590 SC-3: mechanical, whitelisted blind-input extraction.

Run from the repository root. Kept outside the repository; its text is
recorded in the snapshot receipt. Copies instance inputs only (curve A, B;
reference and target x_R). Writes no outcome, arm, trace or run label.
"""
import gzip, json, yaml

RUN = "experiments/EXP-CERTBIN-4e92d7/runs/RUN-CERTBIN-3b7e05"
OUT = "coordination/review/certbin-20260923-c51f07"

curve = json.load(open(f"{RUN}/curve.json"))
refs = json.load(open(f"{RUN}/references.json"))["F-S3"]["references"]
manifest_curve = yaml.safe_load(open(f"{RUN}/manifest.yaml"))["run"]["inputs"]["curve"]

# references: the five arm references (not the modal pseudo-reference), sorted by x_R
ref_ids = [k for k in refs if k != "modal"]
assert sorted(ref_ids) == ["S1", "S2", "U1", "U2", "U3"], ref_ids
ordered = sorted(ref_ids, key=lambda k: refs[k]["x_R"])
assert len({refs[k]["x_R"] for k in ordered}) == 5
labels = ["REF-a", "REF-b", "REF-c", "REF-d", "REF-e"]

# targets: one entry per idx, in file order; assert idx order == file order
seen, order = {}, []
for line in gzip.open(f"{RUN}/targets-F-S3.jsonl.gz", "rt"):
    rec = json.loads(line)
    i = rec["idx"]
    if i in seen:
        assert seen[i] == rec["x_R"], ("x_R differs across D for idx", i)
        continue
    seen[i] = rec["x_R"]
    order.append(i)
assert order == sorted(order) == list(range(order[0], order[0] + len(order))), "index order != file order"
assert len(order) == 1000, len(order)
positions = list(range(10, 1001, 10))

blind = {
    "schema": "certbin.blind_inputs.v1",
    "review_id": "REVIEW-CERTBIN-20260923-c51f07",
    "field": {"n": 17, "modulus": "t^17 + t^3 + 1",
              "encoding": "17-bit integer, bit j = coefficient of t^j"},
    "m": 2,
    "l": 9,
    "D": [4],
    "curve": {"A": curve["A"], "B": curve["B"]},
    "references": [{"label": lab, "x_R": refs[k]["x_R"]} for lab, k in zip(labels, ordered)],
    "targets": [{"position": p, "x_R": seen[order[p - 1]]} for p in positions],
}
key = {
    "references": {lab: k for lab, k in zip(labels, ordered)},
    "targets": {str(p): order[p - 1] for p in positions},
}

# mechanical verification
assert set(blind) == {"schema", "review_id", "field", "m", "l", "D", "curve", "references", "targets"}
assert len(blind["references"]) == 5 and len(blind["targets"]) == 100
for o in blind["references"] + blind["targets"]:
    assert isinstance(o["x_R"], int) and 0 <= o["x_R"] < 2 ** 17
    assert set(o) in ({"label", "x_R"}, {"position", "x_R"})
assert blind["curve"]["A"] == manifest_curve["A"] and blind["curve"]["B"] == manifest_curve["B"]

import os
os.makedirs(f"{OUT}/blind", exist_ok=True)
with open(f"{OUT}/blind/blind-inputs.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(blind, f, indent=1); f.write("\n")
with open(f"{OUT}/blind-inputs-key.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(key, f, indent=1); f.write("\n")
print("ok: 5 references, 100 targets, whitelist and curve checks passed")
